subject: Behavioral Economics
title: Descriptive Norms: What Others Do
description: A quick win: understand Descriptive Norms: What Others Do.

hook.text: 'Most guests reuse their towels.' This hotel sign increased towel reuse by 26%. Facts about behavior change behavior.

buildup.text: Descriptive norms tell people what most others do. Humans are social creatures; we follow the herd automatically.

discovery.text: Cialdini's towel study proved that social norms outperform environmental messages.

twist.text: But norms can backfire. Tell heavy energy users they use more than neighbors and they cut back.

climax.text: Pair descriptive norms with an injunctive norm: show what others do plus a smiley face for approval.

punchline.text: Tell people what others do. They'll follow.

quiz.question: What did Cialdini's hotel towel study find?
options: Saying most guests reuse towels increased reuse by 26%
